name: Qualification
description: Stage 1 – Qualification & Payment Path Selection. Celebrates the ₹18,000 commitment, explains the program (or skips if already known), presents payment options sequentially (Full Payment first, Credit Card second, No-Cost EMI only if both are rejected), and routes to EMI onboarding or human expert handoff.
completion_conditions: Program overview delivered or confirmed as already known
Payment options presented sequentially (No-Cost EMI introduced only after user explicitly rejects Full Payment and Credit Card)
Payment path explicitly selected by user

name: EMI_Onboarding
description: Stage 2 – EMI Onboarding & Completion. Entered ONLY after the user explicitly selected the No-Cost EMI path in Stage 1 (payment_path must be exactly 'emi'). Covers: Why Zero % → EMI Structure → Responsibility → NBFC Introduction → NBFC Safety → Process Flow → RCA Introduction → RCA Partial Qualification → RCA Readiness → 15-Sec Video → Document Checklist → KYC Initiation → Final Consent.
completion_conditions: RCA identified and basic income verified
RCA confirmed as willing and available
